abstract: Glial choristoma of the head and neck is a rare, benign congenital malformation consisting of a mass of heterotopic glial cells. In cases involving the upper aerodigestive tract, this can present with upper airway obstruction. In the acute setting, this can lead to diagnostic challenges due to the broad differential, as well as the additional difficulties in obtaining appropriate imaging and tissue samples due to the potential risk of airway compromise. We present a case of a neonate born with a large heterogenous mass involving the upper aerodigestive tract and multiple deep neck spaces which resulted in upper airway compromise requiring emergency surgical intervention in the form of a paediatric tracheostomy. We will discuss the histological findings which initially suggested a glial choristoma, work-up and treatment of this patient with the aim of supplementing the limited existing clinical knowledge of this congenital anomaly and understanding the implications of a paediatric tracheostomy in our setting.
abstract_ja: 頭頸部の神経膠異所症は、異所性神経膠細胞の塊からなるまれな良性の先天性奇形である。上部消化管に生じた場合、上気道閉塞を呈することがある。急性期には、鑑別診断が多岐にわたること、また気道障害の潜在的リスクのため適切な画像検査や組織検体の採取が困難であることから、診断上の課題が生じうる。本症例は、上部気道消化管および複数の深部頚部間隙に及ぶ大きな不均一な腫瘤を伴って出生した新生児であり、上気道障害をきたし、小児気管切開術による緊急手術を要した。神経膠異所症を示唆した組織学的所見、本患者の診断と治療について論じ、この先天性異常に関する限られた臨床知見を補い、当施設における小児気管切開術の意義を考察する。
